svg.title: Measured roofline with vector-width compute roofs
svg.desc: Four horizontal compute roofs from 13 to 186 GFLOP/s and four bandwidth diagonals; low-intensity kernels sit on the diagonals where wider registers cannot help; the strict-IEEE dot product sits far below every roof.

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measured roofline of one core: vectorization raises the flat roofs, never the slopes

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: GFLOP/s vs FLOP/byte (log-log) · roofs: register-only FMA chains · slopes: AVX-512 saxpy · Xeon (Emerald Rapids), 1 core, gcc 13.3
